notes.title: Summer Content & Animation Update!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/qExSoWz.gif
Update is live, also we increased the bundle discount for this summer! thanks for your support!


 16 new puzzles "summer edition"
 Added the biggest puzzle! more than 7,000 dots!
 New button on bottom left, to watch animation of your finished puzzle.
 Easy to find next number puzzles have the total number of dots in green.
 Hard to find next number puzzles have the total number of dots in red.
 Bigger images when you share them.
 Hotfix: Removed Ads dialog. No SDK or third party software was never installed.
 Hotfix 2: Cloud saves now working.

notes.title: Hotfix update released
notes.content:
HotFix and small improvements update:

    Magnify is now activated by right mouse button
    Fixed "Greater than" Achievements
    Added WASD keys to move around, remember: you can use spacebar to click on a dot


We are working on our next content update, that will come with new puzzles :) including one with more than 7,000 dots!
